items.title_en: Employee Was Honest About Salary During Hiring, Friend Bluffed And Got A Better Package: ‘Did Honesty Cost
items.title_zh: 员工在招聘过程中对薪资很诚实，朋友虚张声势并得到了更好的待遇：“诚实有代价吗？”
items.summary_en: An employee has questioned whether being honest about his current salary cost him a better job offer after his friend reportedly quoted a higher figure and received more.
items.summary_zh: 一名员工质疑，在他的朋友报出更高的工资并收到更多工资后，诚实地透露自己目前的工资是否会让他获得更好的工作机会。
